entities.summary: Anna Yuryevna Pletnyova is a Russian singer, composer, and songwriter. An ex-member of the Russian pop-group Litsey, Pletnyova has been a member of the pop-group Vintage since 2006. In 2016, she left Vintage and started a solo career.
